_doc: Code hooks: located in the EBOOT by masked instruction pattern ('word/mask'), index = which instruction in the pattern is hooked. kind 'value': after the instruction runs, rt = rt_hookval(c, id, rt). kind 'call': the jal at that instruction calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_target) instead. kind 'entry': the function starting at that instruction becomes a thunk that calls rt_hookcall(c, id, original_body). Handlers are in runtime/game.c.

hooks.name: COPTER_LIFT_DT
hooks._doc: Tail Copter: each flap sets the lift time to dt * 4 (4 frames) and accelerates at 30/s while it lasts, so above 30 fps the climb shrank. The lift time is computed from at least 1/30 s, as on the PSP.

hooks.name: SIG_START_DT
hooks._doc: Signature move start (Tails' Tail Copter among others): lift time dt * 4 and an upward kick of 2 * dt * 30, both meant as 4 frames / one frame at 30 fps. Fed at least 1/30 s.

hooks.name: RACER_MOVE
hooks._doc: A racer's move step (racer, dt): pos += vel * dt, then the collide-and-slide pass. Above ~165 fps the steps get so short that a racer sliding into a concave corner (the bottom of a loop, a ramp into a wall) creeps toward it forever instead of crossing onto the next surface; see racer_move() in game.c.
